title: Aethel UI Descriptor
description: Declarative UI descriptor v0.1 (ENG-ADR-089, [DESIGN] gcs-project-management#505 §3). A descriptor is a pure data document: a Control tree, a Theme override, and slot bindings. It carries NO scripting and NO player identity.

version.description: Schema version. v0.1 is the F0.2 bootstrap contract.

control_tree.description: Root Control node of the declarative UI tree.

theme_override.description: Optional per-descriptor Theme item overrides (AethelUI type).

slot_bindings.description: Named runtime slots the host binds at instantiation. Identity is bound HERE at runtime — it is never a literal in the descriptor (see §12 invariant).

identityInvariant.$comment: §12 multiplayer-readiness invariant. Identity is a RUNTIME binding, never embedded as a literal in a UI descriptor. These property names are forbidden ('not': {}) at ANY nesting depth. This canonical list is the single source of truth read by ui_descriptor_validator.gd.

type.description: Godot Control class name (e.g. PanelContainer, Label, Button).

name.description: Optional node name within the tree.

theme_type.description: Optional custom theme type variation (defaults to AethelUI).

$comment: Out of scope for v0.1 (a future ADR is required to add any of these): scripted callbacks (Lua / GDScript-in-JSON), signal-wiring declarations, and animation-curve definitions. v0.1 is strictly declarative.
